components.name: Button
anatomy: Container (.moi-btn) with built-in hit-area / pseudo focus ring
Optional icon-only layout that collapses horizontal padding
notes: Lavender, Warning and Error tokens mirror the Primary and Neutral patterns (solid/outline) but swap color.* scales.
Icon-only buttons drop horizontal padding but maintain the height and radius tokens from buttons.size.<size>.
Active state opacity (0.8) and focus ring opacity (rgba overlays) currently hardcoded and should become dedicated shadow/opacity tokens.

components.name: Input Field
notes: Helper text uses typography.mixins (meduimfont) so rely on typography.fontSize.sm + fontWeight.600.
Select2 dropdown items reuse form-control padding but still rely on hard-coded border colors (#bababa).
Textarea height is hard-coded (150px) and might benefit from spacing tokens if reused.

components.name: Alert
notes: Page-specific helpers (custom-danger-alert/custom-alert-primary) still use raw hex (#d9272d, #0d60da).
Backgrounds should map to color.*.50 tokens instead of hard-coded values for easier theming.

components.name: Badge / Priority Pill

states.filled: Solid OOTD variant flips text to {color.base.white}.

notes: UnderProgress / Returned use raw #6929c4 / #3f739b backgrounds; create tokens for those purple gradients.
Priority pills leverage radius.{radius-100} for pill shape and spacing.$padding-8 for padding.

components.name: Table
notes: Multiple raw colors (#fff, #f4f5fb, #f6f5f1) and shadows should map to color/shadow tokens for predictable theming.
Pagination container uses 0px 8px 20px #f1f1f1 shadow; align to shadow tokens or create dedicated table-shadow token.

components.name: Modal
notes: Close buttons extend %modal-close-button and reuse {color.neutral.800} icons with neutral shadows.
Danger and info headers already map to color tokens; keep focus on replacing any remaining raw colors (e.g., #baige) inside modals.

components.name: Dropdown
notes: Box-shadow and padding are hard-coded (25px); prefer spacing.padding.14 / shadow tokens for consistency.
Toggle arrow remains an svg asset (../images/dovwn-arrow.svg); consider replacing with tokenized icon color {color.neutral.600}.
components.documentationNote: The standalone dropdown.html page was removed (duplicate of treeselect.html). Native select is documented in text-fields.html; searchable/multi/hierarchical lists in treeselect.html.

components.name: Checkbox
notes: Constrain checkbox size to spacing tokens (15px currently hard-coded).
Focus shadow uses rgba with primary; create an opacity token for reuse.

components.name: Radio
notes: Definitions live under #Accidents; generalize to work outside that scope and keep colors tokenized.

No approved reusable public Radio API currently exists — this entry documents the only implementation on file (#Accidents-scoped, css/common/_common.scss). A centralized, page-independent Radio API (e.g. a .moi-radio-* class family) requires explicit Owner Approval before implementation; a prior unapproved attempt (.moi-radio-group) was reverted for this reason. See .ai/KNOWN_DECISIONS.md.
components.status: Page-scoped only (inside #Accidents); needs owner approval before a shared Radio is created.

components.name: Card
components.purpose: Structured content container for record summaries (status header, title, icon, detail rows) used across dashboards and detail pages.

states.note: Primarily a static content container; no dedicated interactive (hover/focus/disabled) states are defined in _card.scss itself.

notes: This entry documents the current, centralized .moi-card component only. It does not cover the separate card-like markup duplicated with raw colors across page-specific SCSS files (dashboard, landing, etc.) noted in the SCSS audit — that fragmentation remains unresolved outside this file.
_card.scss also contains a legacy @import of _customClasses.scss (Sass @import, not @use); left unchanged as it is outside this update's scope.
components.rtlNotes: Layout uses gap/padding tokens under flexbox; no physical left/right properties found in this file.
components.accessibilityNotes: Documentation page includes accessibility guidance; the component itself carries no ARIA roles and relies on heading/landmark markup in the consuming page.

components.name: File Uploader
components.purpose: Drag-and-drop / click-to-browse file upload control with compact and spaced layout options.

states.note: Hover and focus states present in the SCSS; disabled state not independently confirmed in this pass.

notes: Best logical-property RTL usage of any component reviewed in the SCSS audit (5 logical vs 0 physical left/right).
components.rtlNotes: Logical properties used consistently; no left/right physical overrides found.
components.accessibilityNotes: Documentation page has the highest accessibility-guidance coverage of the pages reviewed. Confirm the dropzone has a keyboard-operable native file-input fallback — not independently verified in this pass; Needs Owner Confirmation.

components.name: Stepper
components.purpose: Multi-step progress indicator (wizard) showing current and completed steps.
notes: Class names are documented exactly as implemented, including the existing spellings (Currant, Complated, steeper__footer, wizerd__item). Renaming was out of scope for this update since it would change the markup API.

css/components/_radial-stepper.scss is a separate, visually distinct (circular) implementation not covered by this entry. Whether it should be unified with or documented alongside the linear stepper is Needs Owner Confirmation.
components.rtlNotes: Not independently re-verified in this pass beyond the SCSS audit; treat as unconfirmed pending visual QA.
components.accessibilityNotes: Documentation page covers accessibility guidance. Whether the current step is exposed via aria-current is determined by consuming markup, not enforced by this SCSS file — Needs Owner Confirmation.

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: Toggle control built on Bootstrap's native form-switch markup, restyled with tokenized dimensions.
notes: Includes an explicit @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) override that disables the toggle transition — a genuine accessibility strength not seen elsewhere in the reviewed component set.
components.rtlNotes: Label spacing uses margin-inline-start (logical property) — correct RTL practice. The thumb offset uses left, positioned relative to the track box rather than the viewport, so it is not a direction-mirroring concern.
components.accessibilityNotes: Reduced-motion support confirmed. Verify consuming markup pairs the input with a visible or aria-label'd .form-check-label in all usages — not independently verified in this pass.

components.name: Person Card
components.purpose: Person / identity summary card (photo and key fields) used in records and search results.
notes: Implementation is split across two files. Whether this reflects intentional layering (shared infra vs. page-level usage) or historical duplication was not confirmed in this pass — Needs Owner Confirmation.
components.rtlNotes: Moderate physical/logical property ratio; not fully logical-property based. Not re-verified visually in this pass.
components.accessibilityNotes: Documentation page has noticeably lower accessibility-guidance coverage than the other component pages reviewed — worth a follow-up pass.

components.name: Tags (current .moi-tag API)
components.purpose: Current, data-attribute-driven tag / status-pill component. Distinct from the legacy priority-badge classes already documented above under "Badge / Priority Pill", which remain in active use in the same file.
anatomy: Status dot (::before, hidden automatically when a leading svg/img is present)
notes: tags.html documents both this current .moi-tag API and the legacy priority-badge classes captured under "Badge / Priority Pill" in this same components.json file; both remain live in css/common/_tags.scss today.
This SCSS file was explicitly out of scope for cleanup in this implementation pass; this entry only records what is documented, per Priority 4.
components.rtlNotes: Uses flex layout with gap (logical) for the dot/icon/label arrangement; no left/right physical overrides found in this block.
components.accessibilityNotes: The optional .tag-close button should carry an aria-label in consuming markup when used for removable tags — not enforced by the SCSS itself; Needs Owner Confirmation.

components.name: Notifications (current .moi-notification API)
components.purpose: Current, data-status-driven alert/notification component. This is the component alert.html documents as "Alerts" — the documented concept and the SCSS file/class name differ (Alerts vs. .moi-notification), a naming mismatch carried over from the underlying implementation.
notes: This is the recommended component for new alert/notification development. A separate, older .alert-primary/.alert-danger/.custom-alert-primary/.custom-danger-alert system exists in css/common/_common.scss for backward compatibility only — see alert.html's "Legacy Alerts" section. Do not treat the legacy classes as a second current Alert component.
Action button variant is applied automatically by JavaScript based on data-status; do not set it manually in markup.
components.rtlNotes: Uses a bottom-border-only status indicator and flex layout; no left/right physical overrides found in this file.
components.accessibilityNotes: Use role="alert" for critical/high-impact states; aria-hidden="true" on the icon wrapper; the close button must carry a clear aria-label. See alert.html's Accessibility Guidance section.

components.name: Timeline
components.purpose: Displays a sequence of events or records in chronological order (e.g. case activity log, approval trail, inspection/visit list).
notes: Two structurally distinct patterns coexist in the same file: an alternating left/right card timeline (.timeline) and a date-badge-plus-content-card timeline (.iq-timeline2, reused with different content in .Itinerary). Do not mix the two patterns within the same list.
Static HTML/SCSS display pattern; no JavaScript-driven interactive behavior found in this file.
components.rtlNotes: Not independently re-verified visually in this pass; uses a mix of physical left/right properties for the alternating .timeline pattern (side depends on .right/.left, not automatically flipped).
components.accessibilityNotes: Wrap events in a semantic list where possible; avatar images should carry a descriptive or empty alt; do not rely on color alone (.bg-Date-currant) to mark the current event. See timeline.html's Accessibility Guidance section.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Two separate, page-scoped tab patterns, both layered on Bootstrap's native tabs: circular icon-style tabs, and a bordered card-style tab panel.
notes: The two files are confirmed not to be duplicates — they are visually and structurally distinct, page-scoped skins over Bootstrap's native tabs, not two competing implementations of the same component.
Neither pattern has its own custom JavaScript behavior; both rely on standard Bootstrap tab behavior (data-bs-toggle="tab").
components.rtlNotes: Not independently re-verified visually in this pass.
components.accessibilityNotes: Follow standard Bootstrap/ARIA tab markup (role="tablist"/"tab"/"tabpanel", aria-selected). See tabs.html's Accessibility Guidance section.

components.name: Avatar
components.status: Figma only (42 variants + Avatar Group + presence). No shared class yet.

components.name: Vehicle Card
components.status: Reuses the Person Card shell (.moi-person-card); see vehicle-card.html.

components.name: Image Card
components.status: Matches Figma imageCard-V2: .moi-image-card in css/components/_image-card.scss. Legacy .imagecard in _common.scss kept for existing screens only.

components.name: Radial Stepper
components.status: Not in Figma; now compiled into main.css.

components.name: Breadcrumb
anatomy: Separator owned by the following item (::before chevron mask)
notes: Item max width 240px, current page 320px, single line with ellipsis; full label in title.
Separator mirrors automatically in RTL.
Legacy .breadcrumb-container .breadcrumb in _common.scss is kept for existing screens.

missingComponents.reason: Defined in Figma (Components / Avatar) but there is no shared class; needs owner approval for a .moi-avatar API. Documented in avatar.html.
